proposals.expected_signal: If higher-order collaborative connectivity matters under frozen full-sort evaluation, NDCG@10 should rise through better ranking of tail-relevant positives for users with denser multi-hop structure.
proposals.failure_mode: Over-smoothing across user-item neighborhoods can collapse discrimination, improving training fit while flattening top-10 rank quality.
proposals.hypothesis: Increasing the relative contribution of later propagation layers in a LightGCN-style model will help when useful preference signal arrives through multi-hop item co-consumption rather than only direct interactions.

proposals.expected_signal: If feature interaction inside edges is currently under-modeled, adding transformed neighbor messages should improve top-rank separation beyond pure linear propagation.
proposals.failure_mode: Extra transformation parameters may overfit ML-1M interaction idiosyncrasies or destabilize optimization, yielding worse generalization than simpler propagation.
proposals.hypothesis: Applying learned message transformations during graph aggregation will capture non-linear user-item compatibility patterns that simple normalized propagation misses.

proposals.expected_signal: If representation geometry is the main bottleneck rather than interaction expressivity, auxiliary contrastive pressure should improve embedding separation and modestly lift NDCG@10.
proposals.failure_mode: The auxiliary loss can dominate pairwise ranking and distort the ranking objective, producing cleaner embeddings but worse recommendation order.
proposals.hypothesis: Adding a contrastive auxiliary objective between stochastically perturbed views of user and item embeddings will regularize matrix factorization toward more stable and separable representations.

proposals.expected_signal: If most gain comes from basic factor capacity under the unchanged protocol, a stronger latent-factor baseline should approach graph models and clarify whether graph structure is actually necessary.
proposals.failure_mode: Performance may saturate quickly, showing that additional embedding capacity mainly memorizes popular structure without improving top-10 ranking.
proposals.hypothesis: Scaling latent-factor dimensionality within the same pairwise-ranking setup is a falsification probe for whether graph-specific mechanisms are providing real benefit beyond increased representational capacity.
